verdictRationale: Outcome 'automated_success' indicates compliance requirement is satisfied

registryEntry.label: Verify Intune Removable Storage Restriction Policy
evidence_commands: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations').value | Where-Object { $_.storageBlockRemovableStorage -eq $true -or $_.usbBlocked -eq $true } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ displayName = $_.displayName; id = $_.id; odataType = $_.'@odata.type'; storageBlockRemovableStorage = $_.storageBlockRemovableStorage; usbBlocked = $_.usbBlocked } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

metadata.commandExecuted: [manual/evidence-only] Verify Intune Removable Storage Restriction Policy
